description: Find clichés and empty buzzwords in one of the user's CVs ("team player", "hard-working") and suggest concrete replacements. PRO and AI consent. Use when the user wants their CV to sound less generic.

cvId.description: The id of the CV to use (get it from list_my_takemeup_cvs).

locale.description: Language for results and links (en, de, fr, …). Defaults to the language of the user's TakeMeUp account.

name: detect_takemeup_buzzwords
title: Buzzword detector (PRO)
